activities.activity_description: Add a developer-guide section showing how to obtain and use moduleId/containerId from within a custom module, including a log4j/logback snippet and a Java code example.

activities.activity_name: Design Kafka bus property naming and binding strategy
activities.activity_description: Decide on the exact property names (e.g., kafka.consumer.autoCommitEnabled, kafka.consumer.queueSize, etc.), their mapping to underlying Spring Kafka properties, and how they are merged with defaults.

activities.activity_name: Implement Kafka consumer property overrides
activities.activity_description: Wire autoCommitEnabled, queueSize, maxWait, and fetchSize as bus configuration properties and as stream deployment properties that override the corresponding Spring Kafka consumer settings.

activities.activity_name: Implement Kafka producer property overrides
activities.activity_description: Wire batchSize and batchTimeout as bus configuration and stream deployment properties that override the corresponding Spring Kafka producer settings.

activities.activity_name: Plumb overrides through bus and stream deployment configurations
activities.activity_description: Update the bus and stream property-binding code so the new options are recognized, validated, and applied to the right per-module consumer/producer factory beans.

activities.activity_name: Write unit and integration tests for Kafka overrides
activities.activity_description: Unit tests for the binding logic, plus integration tests that deploy streams with non-default values and assert that the Kafka consumer/producer is configured as expected.

activities.activity_name: Update reference documentation for Kafka bus tuning
activities.activity_description: Add the new properties to the Kafka bus section of the XD reference guide, including a table of property name → underlying setting, defaults, and example stream definitions.

activities.activity_name: Audit existing RPM scripts in XD and XD+Ambari repos
activities.activity_description: Inventory the current contents of both repositories, listing every script, spec file, and helper used to build XD and XD+Ambari RPMs.

activities.activity_name: Design target single-repo structure and naming
activities.activity_description: Decide the directory layout (e.g., xd-rpm/ and xd-ambari-rpm/ at the repo root), the README structure, and how deprecation of the old repos is announced.

activities.activity_name: Migrate scripts into the new public repository
activities.activity_description: Copy/move the scripts and spec files from both source repos into the new single repo while preserving file history where possible.

activities.activity_name: Refactor duplicated logic across the two RPM script sets
activities.activity_description: Identify common functions or build steps duplicated between the XD and XD+Ambari scripts and consolidate them into shared libraries or includes.

activities.activity_name: Update CI build configuration to use the new repo
activities.activity_description: Update the existing CI jobs so they point at the new single repository URL and trigger RPM builds from the correct subdirectories.

activities.activity_name: Test end-to-end RPM build process
activities.activity_description: Run the consolidated build pipeline end-to-end and verify that the produced XD and XD+Ambari RPMs install correctly on a clean target system.

activities.activity_name: Update README and deprecate old repos
activities.activity_description: Write a clear top-level README explaining the new repo, add a deprecation notice in the old repos, and link to the new location from the XD main project README.

activities.activity_name: Code review of all changes
activities.activity_description: Walk through the U1–U8 changes with a peer reviewer, address review comments, and ensure coding-style and test-coverage standards are met.

activities.activity_name: Final cross-feature integration testing
activities.activity_description: Run the full XD single-node and distributed integration test suites to ensure the combined increment (UI change, dependency upgrades, bus config changes, and module ID exposure) works together.

activities.activity_name: Release preparation: notes, changelog, final QA
activities.activity_description: Assemble the final release notes describing all U1–U8 changes, update the changelog, run a final QA pass, and tag the release candidate.
